_comment: Generated by test-pr-guard.sh into its HOME, META_DIR and GITEA_DIR copies and its scripts directory. obs: contributors' requests (creator contrib) to devel:inc, Factory's devel project of each package, which the account maintains; verdict: the incoming review recorded (none: no stamp), with what the case changes: rev (the request's source rev, empty for none), link (the source listing is a _link's), actions (how many), options, target (the target project), stamp_src / stamp_tgt (the stamp's srcmd5 differs from OBS's), devel (the devel package's files now: source, as accepted, or followup, changed since), comment (the text the stamp's sha256 is of). gitea: the devel organisation incorg, whose project git devel:incgit syncs from, its PRs (author, head) and stamps; hold: a FIXABLE PR review whose head files are those of the commit OBS synced; pr_path: where Gitea answers for a PR, kept here since the guard reads the suite; scmsync_owner: a package that syncs from another organisation than its review's. maintainer: the maintainer of a Factory target. files and links: scripts and links written under the suite's scripts directory; record-flag is read from a fixture as the recorder suite reads it, rpx is a renamed link to an rpmspec.
